title: Shopping source of truth (town → NPC → purchase/exchange options)
description: Hand-edited. Towns are an ARRAY (not an object: key order is a formatter away from a silent reshuffle, and objects cannot hold two same-name NPCs in different towns). Same-name NPCs in different towns are separate entries under their own town — supported, not an error. NPC order inside a town and deal order inside an NPC follow the arrays; town display sequence follows TOWN_ORDER (src/lib/towns.ts), not file position. Option shape is strict (additionalProperties false) so typos fail validation. Editors pick this up via the $schema pointer in shops.json.

town.description: One town's merchants, in file order. Town names are unique across the file (same-name NPCs live under different towns).

shop.description: One merchant's options. NPC names are unique within a town, not across towns. Per-merchant metadata lives here (icon today); the town comes from the enclosing entry, never from a field, so the two cannot disagree.

icon.description: Portrait override: path under public/npc served as-is. Omit to use the /npc/<name>.png convention. Exists for the day two same-name NPCs need distinct faces.

kind.description: Omit for shop (counter purchase). Spell out barter for NPC exchanges. Same-name repeats = distinct options.

scope.description: Who the cap binds. account covers the old 伺服器-suffixed caps (today the 11 server-shared barter legs plus two gold rows) and any future per-account cap. Omit for character.

priority.description: In-game recommendation tier (extra renders the 推薦 chip). Omit for unmarked.

id.description: Stable pin id for curated exchanges: pins, sync buckets and defaultPins key on this string, so it must never change shape. Omit only for gold rows, which pin under the derived shop:: id.

barter.description: Legacy display strings for a barter leg, verbatim as authored (×N quirks and 不限次數 kept: the tracker renders these strings, never a recomposition). Present on every barter leg; absent on shop legs.

icon.description: Art override: a data-spelled item name whose public/items file to show instead of this option's own (resolved through itemIconPath, so encoding stays centralized). Omit for own art. Every 卷軸 row points at 任務卷軸 rather than duplicating the paper file per name.

amount.description: What you pay. Gold = per single item (total = amount × qty); item tokens = per whole exchange (total = amount × ceil(qty / get.amount)). Null = unfilled (gold only — token costs always known from routes; enforced by pnpm test:shops).

currency.description: Omit for gold. Otherwise an item token name (e.g. 魔物討伐證明). Check script warns on unknown token names.

get.description: What you receive per exchange. Omit when 1 (the common case). Canonical home for outQty — the overlay writes it back onto routes.

limit.description: Omit entirely when uncapped. Omitted times = uncapped (a bare 1 must be written out); period defaults to daily when times is present, and is rejected without times.
